description: This file contains utility functions for managing workflows, including handling SMS reminders, AI agent call phone numbers, authorization checks, and email template generation within a workflow system.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Determines the sender ID or name based on the action type and step details.

methods.name: upsertSmsReminderFieldForEventTypes
methods.description: Creates or updates SMS reminder fields for specified event types, optionally for organizational scope.

methods.name: removeSmsReminderFieldForEventTypes
methods.description: Removes SMS reminder fields from specified event types, optionally for organizational scope.

methods.name: removeSmsReminderFieldForEventType
methods.description: Removes SMS reminder field for a specific event type.

methods.name: upsertAIAgentCallPhoneNumberFieldForEventTypes
methods.description: Creates or updates AI agent call phone number fields for specified event types.

methods.name: removeAIAgentCallPhoneNumberFieldForEventTypes
methods.description: Removes AI agent call phone number fields from specified event types.

methods.name: removeAIAgentCallPhoneNumberFieldForEventType
methods.description: Removes AI agent call phone number field for a specific event type.

methods.name: getAllUserAndTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Fetches all event types associated with given team IDs and user memberships.

methods.name: isAuthorizedToAddActiveOnIds
methods.description: Checks if a user or team has authorization to add specific event types and routing forms.

methods.name: isStepEdited
methods.description: Determines if a workflow step has been modified.

methods.name: getEventTypeWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves workflows associated with a specific user and event type.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateText
methods.description: Generates email body and subject based on the template type and parameters.
